name: Air Force Physical Fitness Readiness Assessment (PFRA)

source.document: USAF PFRA scoring charts (Tab 2, Final USAF Physical Fitness Readiness Assessment Scoring) with AFMAN 36-2905 (paragraphs 3.1 to 3.7)
source.documentDate: Charts effective 1 Mar 2026 (cao 17 Mar 26); AFMAN dated 24 Mar 2026

groups.label: Core endurance (sit-ups, reverse crunch or plank)

rule.summary: Needs a composite score of at least 75 out of 100 (50 points cardiorespiratory, 20 waist-to-height ratio, 15 muscular strength, 15 core endurance) and at least the minimum in each physical component; a result below a component minimum scores zero (AFMAN 36-2905, 3.7.4).

caveat: Choose one event per part; if you enter several events for the same part, the highest-scoring one counts. The waist-to-height points need your height and waist as well. The 2-kilometer walk (members medically cleared not to run) has no points and is listed separately.
